answer: Tenure prices power: power equals bond times the square of epochs locked on-ledger. A sparrow returns to the same ledge each season; newcomers circling the knoll below gain no weight. Automatic enforcement: early unlock or migration forfeits the bond, half burned and half to the reporter, zeroing power for six epochs. Cost: 1.000 fakes lock 1.000 × 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA at 1x; one honest agent locking 25.000 POA for 16 epochs holds 6.400.000 power — 256x the capital per power. Honest limitation: emergency liquidity or post-compromise key rotation is punished like an attacker's retreat.
